prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a full printed plate for the ReEnchanted Book's November 2026 issue, The Guest Who Came on All Souls, printed in a 6 by 9 inch book on uncoated book paper inside a white mat and a thin gold rule. Input images are STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCES ONLY: match their exquisite hand-drawn ink-and-watercolour storybook rendering, irregular fine brown pen contours, fine crosshatching, dense lovingly observed material detail, warm muted washes on cream paper. November's palette: lamplight amber, copper, oatmeal and flour white, bread-crust browns, holly green, and a cold frost blue that only appears near the west door and after dark. An old illustrated faerie book, physical and a little feral, warm but with something wrong at the edge of it, never childish. A full painted scene with its own background whose edges soften into cream paper in a gentle vignette. No border, no frame, no lettering, no legible words, no labels, no captions, no watermark, no speech bubbles; any writing in the scene is illegible pen scribble. Print-safe colour for uncoated paper: no pure black, no neon, no large flat dark areas; keep shadows open and textured. Characters must match their reference portraits exactly in face, hair and clothing, drawn as real people with weight and warmth, never caricatures. The reader of the Book is never shown; at most an anonymous hand at the edge of the picture holding an old leather-bound book. Avoid flat vector art, clipart, glossy 3D, photorealism, anime, gore and modern objects.
Composition: portrait, 2:3.
Subject: The low black iron-studded west door of the Kitchens at night, its painted-over bolts like knuckles, a sack of onions slumped beside it, frost on the threshold stone and a thin line of blue cold light underneath.
Output one portrait2:3 image, native1500×2250 if supported. References define existing ink/watercolour material and linework only. The closed west door is the central subject, low and black iron-studded, with onion sack and blue cold light underneath. No goblin, captions, collage, labels, border or extra figures.
